overview.description: The Pacer Aristotle Pacific Floating Rate High Income ETF (FLRT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fund targeting floating-rate US debt from non-investment-grade issuers. FLRT was launched on Feb 19, 2015 and is issued by Pacer.
